study: The last Kraken avenue: the 84 coins §4.22's cost-and-book screen passed and could not test — does any clear §4.15's bar on Kraken's costs and Kraken's book, on SEEDED parameters, on both walk-forward windows?

rulebooks.what: the shipped rule at its seeded point (DEFAULT_TREND); the shipped 27-point grid for the plateau
§3.12's one slow variant: slow 200, breakout 100/36, ATR 4; its 8-point grid for the plateau

declared.bar: §4.15's four tests from Kraken's side (§4.16): return > 0 on Kraken's costs, drawdown < 35 %, plateau ≥ 50 % of the grid positive on Kraken's costs, return > 0 on the other schedule — on BOTH A and B — and a Kraken book ≥ $100k a day
declared.costs: Kraken: 40 bps maker a side (post-only, as the loop rests there) plus half the screen's measured spread. Other schedule: the REAL Revolut X UK cost (9 bps taker plus half its measured UK spread) for a Kraken-cheaper coin; Revolut X's fees at Kraken's spread for a Kraken-only coin (§3.14's CHEAP schedule). Spreads are the screen's medians rounded to 0.01 bps, as §4.22 carried them.
declared.continuity: each scored segment, warm-up included, has at most 2 % of its bars without a trade (omitted by the CSV, or zero volume from the endpoint)
declared.history: a window is scored only when the coin's tape holds all of it plus the rulebook's warm-up before it; never shortened
declared.null: for each rulebook: N·pA·pB (independence at the observed per-window rates) and N·p² (pooled rate), with P(≥ observed) under Binomial(N, pA·pB)
declared.search: reported beside the seeded cells and counted nowhere; in-sample from the grid's first bar or the listing, ≥ 180 days, chosen on Kraken's costs by return over drawdown
declared.notAssets: §3.14's stablecoin / fiat and wrapped sets, plus USDe

bundle.coverage: every pair from its first trade to 2026-06-30

liveEndpoint.endpoint: GET https://api.kraken.com/0/public/OHLC?pair=<alt>&interval=240 (keyless, 720 most recent candles; the forming last row dropped)

tapes.note: this file's splice and fill, trimmed to §4.22's grid, against the tapes §4.22 read, aligned by timestamp. Prices must be identical; volume is reported apart because `run` never reads it (the seam bars take volume from whichever source a day's fetch window started on)

published422OnTheirTapes.note: the same method on §4.22's own tapes: proof that the typed-in numbers are the ones those tapes produce

published422Seeded.note: §4.22's t1_seeded: ret, maxDD, trades and the other schedule's ret, per coin × rulebook × window, re-derived from this file's tapes and costs by `run` itself

published422Folds.note: §4.22's 216 fold returns for its 18 coins and 120 for the live five (Revolut X taking the touch, and Kraken), re-derived the same way

headline.nullStatedFirst: for each rulebook, N·pA·pB expected two-window passes if a coin's two windows were independent draws at the observed per-window rates (§4.22's 3.33 is this sum); N·p² with p pooled over both windows beside it

falsification.rule: §4.22's written falsification with only its three-year requirement relaxed to the two windows: a two-window SEEDED pass on all four tests AND positive in at least 4 of the six folds

coinLevel.note: one coin passing on both rulebooks is one coin: a window counts as passed when EITHER rulebook passes it

closing.note: §4.22's 18 plus this study's two-window coins, all four tests, seeded, one rule set

oneWindow.note: a one-window pass is not a qualification (§3.15: in all four stop × parameter conditions a coin that cleared window A was LESS likely to clear B); reported so nothing is hidden
a one-window pass is not a qualification (§3.15: in all four stop × parameter conditions a coin that cleared window A was LESS likely to clear B); reported so nothing is hidden

continuityWaived.note: every A or B segment the 2 % continuity rule dropped, scored anyway — SENSITIVITY, counts for nothing; answers whether the rule threw a winner away

folds.note: same six folds, same history and continuity rules, seeded, nothing chosen. The live five and §4.22's 18 are re-scored here on full tapes so every cohort's fold is the same calendar span; §4.22's own figures are the fidelity block's

grossEdge.note: the SAME seeded cells at ZERO cost (no fee, no spread): the rule's edge before any venue charges it, per round trip (trades / 2), pooled as Σ ln(1 + ret) / Σ round trips over every A-scored (B-scored) cell of this study's coins. A venue whose round trip costs more than this cannot be the right venue for these coins at any fee tier it offers. `yardstick` is the same arithmetic for the live five and §4.22's 18

ownThirds.note: §3.8's split (each coin's own tape in thirds, ≥ 540 days) — SENSITIVITY, counts for nothing; a coin with three years or more is cut on its last three, which is the calendar split

reopen.note: when each coin will hold two full calendar windows (the two latest years plus warm-up) and three years of tape, if the windows roll forward with time

verdict: NO coin clears the bar as written. 2 two-window seeded passes (1 coin: TAO/USD) against 0.7 expected by chance (per rulebook P = 0.1829 / 0.4033; coin level 1 against 0.6, P = 0.4614), and every passer fails the fold test (trend-4h·TAO/USD 2/4; trend-4h-wide·TAO/USD 2/4; 4 positive needed). Across every Kraken-advantaged coin with two windows (§4.22's 18 and these): 3 coins against 3.26 by chance (P = 0.6489); fold test 0 of 3 passers
